Pepperoni Pizza Rolls
By: Cindy Fanning
Published: Saturday, February 1, 2014 - 10:17am

Ingredients




1 cup warm water (100° to 110°)
10 ounces bread flour (2 cups )
1 package dry yeast (about 2¼ teaspoons)
1 Tbsp olive oil
½ tsp kosher salt
Filling
7 ounces sliced pepperoni
12 (4½-inch) sticks mozzarella string cheese

Preparation

1 For Pizza Dough 2 Weigh or lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups and spoons; level with a knife. Add flour, salt and yeast to large bowl. Add olive oil to one side of bowl. Slowly add in water and stir with wooden spoon to combine. 3 Once dough comes together, place on lightly floured counter and knead to form soft elastic dough. Place dough in large bowl lightly coated with olive oil. Gently roll dough around bowl to coat. Cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled in size. 4 Assembly 5 Microwave pepperoni in small bowl for 1 minute. 6 Separate any pepperoni that are stuck together and microwave for another 25 seconds. 7 Carefully, place pepperonis on a plate lined with a paper towel. Pat dry. 8 Press or roll dough out to a 10 x 16 rectangle on a lightly floured counter-top. 9 Divide dough in half lengthwise. 10 One the long end begin spreading pepperoni and top with mozzarella cheese sticks to form a line. 11 Fold dough over pepperoni and cheese to seal. 12 With a sharp knife divide into 2-3 inch pieces. 13 Shape is piece into a roll, being sure to seal open areas. 14 Repeat with the rest of the dough. 15 Place rolls on a baking sheet about 2 inches apart. Cover and let rise for 30 minutes. 16 Lightly butter tops of rolls. 17 Bake at 400 degrees until golden.

About

Pepperoni Pizza Rolls...deliciously soft and cheesy
